units.source_text: 这座殿堂颜色雪白，点着五光十色的灯火。

en.t: This temple hall was snow white, lit with lamps of many colors.

units.source_text: 有的地方一片红光，还有……蓝光，正中像是橘色的光。

en.t: Some places were filled with red light, and there was also... blue light, while the center seemed to glow orange.

units.source_text: 这些颜色不是我刚才谈话中所思慕的那种鲜艳的颜色，而是真正柔和的色调。

en.t: These colors were not the vivid colors I had yearned for in the conversation just now, but truly gentle tones.

units.source_text: 于是那个人（富伊依达把莱蒙特称作那个人）便注意观察这些彩色光是从哪儿投来的。

en.t: Then that man, as Fuida called Remont, carefully looked to see where these colored lights were coming from.

units.source_text: 接着他看到许多大窗户，窗上镶有这些颜色的玻璃。

en.t: Then he saw many large windows, fitted with glass in those colors.

units.source_text: 殿堂里的人正向透过红色玻璃幻化成粉红色的地方走去，

en.t: The people in the hall were walking toward places where the light, passing through red glass, had changed into pink,

units.source_text: 要么站在那里，要么站在蓝光之中。

en.t: either standing there or standing within the blue light.

units.source_text: 也有的人沐浴着橘色的或黄色的光。

en.t: There were also people bathed in orange or yellow light.

units.source_text: 那个人心想，为什么大家要这样做呢？

en.t: That man wondered to himself why everyone was doing this.

units.source_text: 于是有人告诉他：粉红色是爱的光，蓝色是真正医治心灵的光，而橘色则是智慧的光。

en.t: Then someone told him: pink is the light of love, blue is the light that truly heals the soul, and orange is the light of wisdom.

units.source_text: 他们向各自企求的光走去，并站在那里。

en.t: They walked toward the light each of them sought, and stood there.

units.source_text: 据向导说：这比世人所知道的要可贵得多。

en.t: According to the guide, this was far more precious than people in the world understood.

units.source_text: 就是在现今的世上，有朝一日也会有人进一步研究各种光的效果的。

en.t: Even in the present world, one day people will further study the effects of various kinds of light.
